draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise perturbation experiment; only original-label F1 (T1) is reported. The robustness criterion and noise conditions are described but never run. The claim about robustness to label noise has no supporting evidence.

judgement.proposition: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in training annotations
judgement.expressed_strength: "appears somewhat robust" — hedged, weak claim about robustness to label noise
judgement.strongest_supported: No evidence in the package evaluates label noise; the only results are on original labels (T1), so no claim about robustness to label noise is supported.
